desc: Formalize A/B as 0^X1^Y <-> 1^Y0^X; derive invariants (ordered 1-positions mod X, ordered 0-positions mod Y, preserved counts/order) and prove they are necessary conditions.
Implement candidate O(N) criterion (X+Y>N ⇒ S==T; else both ordered residue lists must match); samples pass and exhaustive N≤8 agreement confirmed.

Exhaustively validate criterion via union-find for all N≤12, all valid (X,Y), plus N=13..15 spot checks (including balanced X=Y pairs targeting the gcd(X,Y)>1 risk); no MISMATCH found, criterion confirmed as component⇔signature bijection.

Finalize O(N) solution with fast stdin/stdout I/O; verified Sample 1 (Yes) and Sample 2 (No) and edge cases (X+Y>N, count_ones<Y, count_zeros<X, all-0/all-1); algorithm runs in O(N) time/space well within limits for N=5×10^5.
